tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (4.5:1).

tokens.name: color-dna-teal
tokens.usage: Life sciences innovation, genetic precision, molecular. Used as text on `.logo-icon`, `.btn-secondary`; border on `.content-card:nth-child(1)`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-innovation-green
tokens.usage: Growth trajectories, living systems, cellular health,. Used as border on `.stat-card:nth-child(2)`, `.content-card:nth-child(2)`; text on `.stat-trend`, `.footer-link:hover`. 2.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
